plan.p0: Replace every 2 with a centered five-cell horizontal object: [5,5,1,5,5], preserving all other cells. The distinguishing assumption is that every marker is independently active and the stamp may overwrite existing cells.
plan.p1: Treat each 2 as the center of a left-anchored five-cell bar whose pattern is [1,5,5,5,5], as observed. Unlike p0, the stamp is clipped at borders and does not overwrite non-background cells; collisions retain the pre-existing object.
plan.p2: Interpret the 2s as coordinates generated by a hidden horizontal-template layer. Reconstruct the template at every listed coordinate, but apply it only when the target five-cell span is entirely background; otherwise leave that marker unchanged. This differs on crowded or boundary cases.
plan.p3: Use each 2 as a seed for a directional replacement: draw [1,5,5,5,5] with the 1 two columns left of the seed, but only for seeds belonging to the dominant background-colored component. Isolated seeds in a differently colored region would be ignored.
